purpose: Teach: 農政/国民党/生育/深層/重度/照射/同和/音程

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、農政動向に応じた商品戦略をとれ
lines.en: We need to align our product strategy with agricultural policy shifts.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with precision—no hesitation. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。台湾国民党系の取引先との関係も大事にします
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure to maintain our relationships with our Taiwan-affiliated partners.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Lean slightly forward. Steady voice—not rushed, showing he's genuinely absorbing the directive. A nod embedded in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の生育、つまり育成計画を整えろ
lines.en: And establish a proper training and development plan for new hires.
lines.style: Same measured authority as the first line. Slight pause before 'training'—letting the weight of the priority land. Calm but unmissable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。深層顧客分析を導入します
lines.en: Yes. We'll implement deeper customer analysis to support that.
lines.style: Thoughtful, demonstrating he's connecting the dots. Voice carries the satisfaction of understanding the bigger picture. Clear and engaged, not just obedient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 重度の不採算事業から撤退する判断もしろ
lines.en: We also need to make the hard call to exit unprofitable operations.
lines.style: Firmer now. A slight edge underneath the composure—this is the directive that costs something. No softening, but no harshness either. The voice of someone who's made tough decisions before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の品質照射試験を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our product quality and inspection protocols.
lines.style: Swift confirmation. He's keeping pace, unruffled by the increasing difficulty. Steady cadence—showing he can handle what's being asked without breaking stride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同和問題への配慮も社員教育に含めろ
lines.en: Include proper training on social responsibility issues in staff education as well.
lines.style: Deliberate, serious tone. A slight drop in pitch on 'responsibility'—this matters beyond the business line items. The clarity of someone setting a value, not just a procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレゼンの音程にも気を配ります
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll ensure every presentation reflects the standard you're setting.
lines.style: Final affirmation. A touch warmer than before—he's not just taking orders, he's absorbed the broader vision. The close of a conversation where understanding has deepened.
